//: Mirrors the upstream console tsconfig (jsx: react-jsx, @/* alias)
while staying compatible with the qwenpaw-pet plugin layout (single
tsconfig, types stay minimal so the bundle never grabs Node globals).
We DO let @types/react register here (unlike qwenpaw-pet) because all
the copied console sources use modern `import React from "react"` /
automatic JSX — they need real React types. There is no `const React =
host.React` line in the source that would collide with the global.
